title: Cross-parity defect A=-g.B and Conj 1.12 anti-spreading are DUAL halves of one subset-sum image S0
wall: W-largesieve (sum-product / BGK): both faces collapse to additive-energy / sum-product expansion of the subset-sum image S0 mod the fully-split prime
evidence: Three exact-integer probes at PROPER subgroups (prize regime n=8/16/32, q=n^4..n^5, n|q-1, large prime, NOT full group) in scripts/probes/_407_conn/probe_C042_{crossparity_dual,identity_and_lever,avg_forcing}.py (outputs in _out_C042_avg.txt). (1) THE IDENTITY is exact but tautological: #{(A,B) in S0^2: A=(-g)B} == |S0 cap (-g)S0| matched 6/6 (part A) -- but this holds for ANY dilate constant c (it is the definition of a multiplicative-dilate self-intersection), so it is a faithful re-expression, not new content. (2) The EXACT averaging identity AVG_{h in Fq*} |S0 cap hS0| = |S0\{0}|^2/(q-1) (+1 from the 0-fixpoint) was verified to the decimal: n=8 q=4129 AVG=2.5504=pred; n=16 q=65537 AVG=657.6406=pred. (3) FORCING: Conj 1.12 spreading |S0|>=q/10 therefore forces AVG_h intersection >= (q/10)^2/(q-1) ~ q/100 = Theta(q). The cross-parity dilate -g is a FIXED value (not chosen to minimize) and empirically sits at the ~98.5-98.8 percentile of dilate self-intersections (near the MAXIMUM) at n=16 q=n^4 and q=n^5. Hence when Conj 1.12 holds, |S0 cap (-g)S0| = Theta(q): the image cannot be both additively spread AND multiplicatively thin under -g. (4) MERSENNE extreme confirmed: at n=32 q=n^4 the subset-sum image fills F_q (|S0|=q) so |S0 cap (-g)S0|=q (max defect) -- consistent with the in-tree sumsetDistinct_signedPowers_eq_univ giving S0=univ for q=2^p-1, but that is the WORST case for a prize floor, not a usable one.
honest_note: C042's IDENTITY sub-claim is PROVEN (exact, tautological re-expression) and the 'Mersenne maximizes the defect' extreme is confirmed -- these are genuine, the connection faithfully turns the §17 prose into a precise set statement. But the load-bearing 'DUAL halves you can play against each other' insight FAILS: the two faces are ANTAGONISTIC, not dual. By the Cauchy-Schwarz averaging identity (machine-verified), large |S0| (Conj 1.12 spreading) forces large self-intersection at EVERY dilate on average, and the fixed cross-parity dilate -g is near-maximal, so spreading forces Theta(q) cross-parity defect. There is no independent multiplicative lever: both quantities are governed by the additive-energy / sum-product expansion of the subset-sum image mod the fully-split prime. This is exactly the conclusion RESULTS-407-LACUNARY-RIGIDITY.md §17 reached itself ('the most promising direction is ALSO the sum-product wall, loophole closed'). Net: OPEN, welds to BGK/sum-product (W-largesieve). No closure; not a refutation of any in-tree lemma (the SubgroupSumsetConjecture stays an honest named open Prop, mersenne_admissible stays correct). Probes are exact integer arithmetic; the percentile of -g is empirical (sampled ~400 dilates per prime), and the small-n full-image flooding (n=32 fill=1) is partly the #400 small-n artifact -- but the averaging FORCING is a rigorous Cauchy-Schwarz fact independent of n.
